# Susan Shepard — GRC Engineering Portfolio

> Personal portfolio for FAIR cyber risk quantification, compliance-as-code, and AI-assisted GRC. The page is this site; the code that ships lives under RootCaws LLC.

This is a recruiter-facing site, not a production assurance platform.

## This site

- [Portfolio](https://xnasusx.github.io/portfolio/): programs, public builds, and the risk lab
- [Risk lab](https://xnasusx.github.io/portfolio/#/risk-tools): eight interactive tools, embedded from their own repositories
- [Source (published)](https://github.com/xnasusx/portfolio)
- [Profile README](https://github.com/xnasusx)

## Live builds

- [u dont GRC me](https://rootcawsllc.github.io/u-dont-grc-me/): control-centric GRC prototype. Agent index: [llms.txt](https://rootcawsllc.github.io/u-dont-grc-me/llms.txt). Source: [RootCawsLLC/u-dont-grc-me](https://github.com/RootCawsLLC/u-dont-grc-me)
- [proofplane](https://rootcawsllc.github.io/proofplane/): AI governance control plane that treats a control as held only when an executed attack failed. Source: [RootCawsLLC/proofplane](https://github.com/RootCawsLLC/proofplane)
- [cui-control-plane](https://github.com/RootCawsLLC/cui-control-plane): one control inventory for a DoD CUI boundary; command-line pipeline, nothing deployed
- [ksi-harness](https://github.com/RootCawsLLC/ksi-harness): continuous control monitoring for FedRAMP 20x; command-line pipeline, nothing deployed
- [proofscan](https://github.com/RootCawsLLC/proofscan): layered application flaw scanner; command-line, nothing deployed
